item.text: The ordinary Galaxy route is faithful: convert the Zebra Finch CSV to tabular, use Galaxy’s numeric `Filter` on column 8 (`MethylationPercentage`) with `10 <= value <= 90` (the rows removed), then count output lines with Galaxy’s line-count tool. Boundaries are included because the requested retained condition is strictly `>90%` or `<10%`.

The first Galaxy submission was stopped at input validation because the dataset reference needs Galaxy’s structured history-item format; no job was submitted. I’m correcting that reference and will continue with the same copied-history route.

Galaxy completed all three jobs successfully in the copied history. The filtered dataset contains exactly the rows meeting `10 <= MethylationPercentage <= 90`; I’m downloading only Galaxy’s line-count result to read the scalar and verify the final history state.
